name: Winifred Christabel Hopkins
bio: Harry Marillier's second wife, married in 1906 - daughter of the artist Arthur Hopkins, and herself the composer of 'The Rose and the Ring'. They had one son.
bio_note: No dates given in the source read. She is one of the few spouses on this map with a recorded creative work of her own, which is why the composition is named here.
roster_note: Added 2026-08-05 in the pass that put every spouse and every off-roster person on the map.
